The 1865 article is unsigned, and Butler’s 1901 preface mentions only “a second article on the same subject … in the Press shortly after the first, but I have no copy”, without a title or date. The dataset’s attribution rests on a textual match with Erewhon (its document description), not on a cited authority. An authorship record would be an inference from that match; it needs a competent bibliographic source (for example a Butler bibliography) or the maintainer’s decision.
